claude.rationale: This was an equity purchase of all outstanding interests of IODC and its U.S. subsidiaries "as a going concern," so the customer-facing facilities (728,000 sq ft, four data centers, the Cyxtera anchor lease) and the operating company/facilities operations "transferred together" — product and process moved coherently, so gap_45=0. The acquirer's statement welcoming "our expanded team of experienced and highly skilled professionals" indicates the operating workforce (T6) moved with the operations (T5), so gap_56=0. No transitional-services or shared-services agreement was disclosed, but since no gap was coded, mitigation is NA.

gemini.rationale: The slice explicitly states that the transaction was an equity purchase of the operating entity, meaning the data center facilities (T4) and their operations (T5) transferred together as a going concern. Furthermore, the acquirer welcomed the 'expanded team of experienced and highly skilled professionals,' indicating the workforce (T6) moved alongside the operations, resulting in no structural gaps at closing.

openai.rationale: The customer-facing data-center facilities and customer relationships transferred together with IODC’s operating entity and the facilities’ operations as a going concern, so no product-process mismatch is documented at closing [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-18-001664, Form 8-K Item 2.01; Form 8-K EX-99.1]. The acquired workforce was described as an expanded team of experienced professionals welcomed into Iron Mountain, indicating that the people running the transferred operations moved with them; therefore, no process-organization gap is documented [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-18-001664, Form 8-K EX-99.1].
